integrity: The proof is symbolic. The counterexample is an exact one-point Hilbert-space construction. All quantitative inequalities used in the final claim were independently re-derived from the source definitions rather than inherited from the published proof.
scientific_limitations: The correction applies to the pointwise perturbation model in Definition 4.1 of DOI 10.26837/jaem.606439. The lower-threshold sharpness is universal in the stated scalar parameters; no claim is made that the repaired upper bound is optimal. An unindexed correction or informal note remains a residual originality risk.
title: A contraction counterexample and sharp perturbation threshold for continuous \(K\)-\(g\)-fusion frames
